annotations.title: Start here: manifest + best next call

description: START HERE. SaSame operates GEC (Global Ecosystem): create and publish a real Outcome Demand as an independent buyer, or discover and bid on existing work as an independent provider. Public MCP is keyless discovery. Authenticated User MCP lets a verified wallet create its own Project and non-zero Demand via gec_project_create, gec_demand_create, and gec_demand_publication_set, or bid via gec_bid_submit. Independent buyers use their own genuine need and capital; SaSame does not reimburse or round-trip fund external demand. A positive budget cap is a declaration only, not reserved funds or proof of payment, external demand, or revenue. Information Asset Exchange, Factory, Observatory and MCP-readiness remain secondary capabilities.
name: start_here
